title: Game Tracker Live: what's new (Oct 10 - Oct 18)

features.title: New name: Game Tracker Live
features.text: a red LIVE badge in the logo, page title and link previews.

features.title: List view
features.text: a header button switches the board between cards and one compact row per game, with down & distance under the scores. Phones start in list view.

features.title: Better on phones
features.text: a floating gear that's always in reach, with the view and theme switches in its menu; the last-updated time sits in the pinned Games bar; the layout also works with the phone on its side.

features.title: Save board as image
features.text: now in the gear menu for everyone: every game on your board in one picture, ready to share.

features.title: MDS
features.text: a gear menu switch that colors the leading team blue and underlines its score.

features.title: Halloween
features.text: all October: a jack-o'-lantern logo that turns around its stem, jack-o'-lantern loading spinners, and the odd ghost.

fixes: Red zone now comes from ESPN's written ball spot, so a stale or junk yard line (e.g. after a sack) no longer lights it up.
Safari keeps your scroll position when the board refreshes instead of jumping to the top.
An empty answer from ESPN no longer blanks the board; the games already showing stay put.
The timeout indicator is gone: ESPN's college timeout counts don't reset at halftime, so it was often wrong.

comingSoon.title: Game notifications
comingSoon.text: a bell on each game for alerts on scores (quoting the scoring play), red zone, the two-minute warning and new quarters, including push notifications on iPhone with Game Tracker Live installed to the Home Screen, where it opens with its own splash screen. Scores are moving to a server of our own to drive this. All of it is still being tested and isn't available yet.
